verdict.rationale: Docs describe official generated clients for the Inference API across Connect/gRPC/Protobuf ecosystems in Go, Python, TypeScript, Java, Kotlin, Rust, and Swift, plus a Terraform provider for infra-as-code, showing genuine SDK/IaC coverage for AI-native builders. Missing for 10: dedicated SDK repos/package names, versioning or release cadence details, and SDK coverage beyond inference/Terraform (e.g. storage, CKS API) with independent developer corroboration.
